Deeper confusion after glucose means the cofactor was already replete
The sugar drives a pathway that uses up the last of the missing cofactor
Unsteady walking means glucose is the cofactor he lacks
Eyes that will not move mean sugar replaces the cofactor
correctAnswer: The sugar drives a pathway that uses up the last of the missing cofactor
explanation: Glucose before the vitamin worsens him because the remaining cofactor is consumed by the metabolism the glucose starts. The sugar drives a pathway that uses up the last of the missing cofactor. Unsteady walking means glucose is the cofactor he lacks is thiamine. Eyes that will not move mean sugar replaces the cofactor are the syndrome the cofactor treats. A starving patient is harmed by the cofactor and helped by glucose alone is the reverse order. Deeper confusion after glucose means the cofactor was already replete means the last of it was consumed.

examTakeaway: The neutrophil count is low because the enlarged spleen is sequestering cells, not because the marrow stopped.
scenario: A 60-year-old patient with long-standing small-joint disease has an enlarged spleen and a neutrophil count of 400. The marrow shows neutrophil precursors. A classmate says a count of 400 means the marrow is empty. The joints are the same disease he has had for years. There is no chemotherapy.
question: Why is the count low if the marrow still has precursors?
options: No chemotherapy means the spleen cannot enlarge
The spleen is holding the neutrophils, so they are made and not circulating
Precursors in the marrow mean neutrophils cannot be sequestered
Long-standing small-joint disease empties the marrow of white-cell precursors
A neutrophil count of 400 with an enlarged spleen is a production failure
correctAnswer: The spleen is holding the neutrophils, so they are made and not circulating
explanation: The neutrophil count is low because the enlarged spleen is sequestering cells, not because the marrow stopped. The spleen is holding the neutrophils, so they are made and not circulating. Precursors in the marrow mean neutrophils cannot be sequestered mean they are being made.
